intro: Forty-nine changes in a single day. Here are ten you'll notice.

1.headline: Signed out? The Welcome page offers GitHub sign-in
1.say: The Welcome page now offers GitHub sign-in when you're signed out.

before.text: Try out the new Agents window

2.headline: Session rows lead with New Nested Session
2.say: A session's first button now starts a nested session.

3.headline: The app icon now shows the badge
3.say: The app icon now shows the badge.

4.headline: /fork, with a title or with a prompt
4.say: Fork a chat with a title, or a prompt to send right away.

5.headline: Plugin links that ask before they act
5.say: Plugin links now ask before adding or installing anything.

6.headline: Save a whole image batch as one ZIP
6.say: Save a whole batch of generated images as one ZIP.

7.headline: Language Status says when diagnostics are cut
7.say: Language Status now says when some diagnostics aren't shown.

8.headline: Removed steering messages stay removed
8.say: Remove a queued steering message, and the agent never gets it.

params.message: Also add a test for the empty state

9.headline: Cloud Sandbox sessions keep their model picker
9.say: Reopened Cloud Sandbox sessions get their model picker back.

context.prompt: Run the unit tests and fix what fails.
context.reply: All 214 tests pass now: the date parsing in utils/date.ts handled time zones wrong, and the fix is in.

10.headline: Find sessions by pull request number
10.say: And find any session by its pull request number.

sessions.title: Fix flaky terminal tests
sessions.prompt: Find out why the terminal tests are flaky and fix them.

sessions.title: Welcome page sign-in
sessions.prompt: Offer GitHub sign-in on the Welcome page when signed out.
